stations.title: Femi
stations.say: My merge went red, so I left it.
stations.note: And my June find is ready.

stations.title: main
stations.text: Wilma added a book at the same spot.

captions: Femi left a merge open, and his June find is waiting to go on the site.
Wilma added a book at the same spot, so Git stops and asks.
You call off one merge, settle a conflict and finish another, in three tasks.
Both new books are on the shop's list, and no merge is left open.
Two changes met, and a person decided how they fit.
